decision.scope: The ident-interning revisit trigger from decision 0001, executed as beads catherine-6g2: a new interned execution core (crates/catherine-core/src/engine/, split under the complexity caps into mod/compile/families/render/lane) — dense id assignment in canonical order, EngineSchema/EngineInstance/EngineTyped over Vecs, the build classification shared by TypedInstance::build (delegated) and the check walk (checks::check rewired; the parsed-path family walkers deleted), findings emitted in taxonomy order via pure-int sort keys exactly equivalent to Finding::cmp (id order is name order by construction). Parsed surface behavior unchanged and pinned by the 169 catherine-core tests, the ah check contract suite, golden fixtures, and parity nets; cargo fmt/clippy -D/cargo test --workspace green, plus a pre-existing ci breakage fixed (cfg(kani) registered in the crate lints so clippy -D warnings stops failing every checkout). Lane-side: shapes/soundness harnesses rewritten over the lane flavor (id keys only, no String materialization, findings asserted over int keys, witness re-derivation independent of the walk). Measured under Kani 0.68.0 / CBMC 6.11.0, unwind 16, this session's probe matrix: BTreeMap over symbolic content is fatal at ANY key type (u32-keyed insert of symbolic cells: harness timeout at 180 s — 0001's String verdict was the key type, not the map); a &str inside a sort comparator is fatal (memcmp churns to the unwind cap) while the identical sort with pure-int keys proves in seconds; String allocation/drop/swap in the harness path is fatal even for a dozen concrete names; Vec-of-Vec over symbolic scalars with concrete loop bounds proves in seconds; Option<struct> payloads are free. CONSTRUCTION VERIFIED: the lane flavor's schema+instance construction (EngineSchema::lane + instance_for) verifies in ~26 s end-to-end — the first in-budget Kani verification this lane has produced. STILL HELD: engine_build and the check walkers over symbolic cells do not complete at 380 s wall (probe_build_only), while the near-identical standalone probe completes in ~15 s; the residual cost is interprocedural Vec machinery over symbolic-length content in the in-crate context (zero unwind markers; preallocation and branchless appends did not clear it). Dispositions updated in docs/kani-lane.md accordingly.
decision.rationale: Hold maintained: construction alone does not satisfy the harness obligations (tasks 3-5 need build/check verdicts), and the remaining wall is measured, not assumed — six modeling-cost hypotheses were eliminated by probe (maps at any key type, str comparators, String allocs, struct payloads, pointer-check volume, unwind assertions), leaving interprocedural symbolic-length flow as the recorded residue. Revisit triggers, replacing 0001's: (1) a Kani release where vec_push_within_capacity stabilizes (replacing the capacity-asserted append helper, measured necessary after the alloc-branch churn finding), or whose alloc modeling stops exploring growth branches on symbolic lengths — re-run probe_build_only first; (2) a standalone verification crate wrapping the engine behind a pub API, if in-crate symex overhead is confirmed as the delta (the standalone probe's 10x gap is the evidence to chase); (3) solver-level tuning via --cbmc-args if a profile shows solver rather than symex time. Hold keeps everything honest: the parsed kernel is byte-identical and CI-green, the construction proof is real and recorded, undetermined stays loud, and nothing is cited as proved. Extend still funds nothing: phase-2 families would multiply spend against the same wall.
decision.fixture_only_comparison: Unchanged from 0001 at the assurance level: fixture-corpus parity and hegel sampling stay green through the engine rewiring (169 core tests + the ah contract suite), so the rewrite bought no regression. What Kani would add when build/check clear is unchanged too — exhaustive-within-bounds panic/overflow-freedom and witness soundness. What this arc bought: the wall moved from 'nothing completes at any budget' to 'construction verifies in ~26 s; build+check held with a measured, mechanistic disposition', plus a one-implementation kernel (build delegated to the engine) whose structure no longer requires String-keyed map ops on any proven path.
